source: Natural Earth 1:10m Admin 1 – States, Provinces and 1:50m Admin 0 – Countries and 1:10m Populated Places (public domain, naturalearthdata.com, v5.1.1 via github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector); terrain guess from NASA Blue Marble GEBCO topography (public domain). Regions merged by scripts/build-map.ts.
notes: Region population = country population (Natural Earth POP_EST) × populationShare, where share = ½·area share + ½·city-population share. Terrain is a heuristic from elevation statistics and latitude. Sea zones are k-means cells over ocean pixels (names: basin + nearest coastal country), except the enclosed and marginal seas carved out by scripts/fix-sea-zones.ts (`enclosed: true`), which follow their real coastlines and straits and carry their own names.
